say:1:1630337101:1.text: Oh, you mean how people there don't talk to you, right?
say:1:1630337101:1.source_cn: 哦，对，那些人都不敢跟你说话，是吧？
say:1:1630337101:1.male: Oh, you mean how people there don't talk to you, right?
say:1:1630337101:1.female: Oh, you mean how people there don't talk to you, right?

say:2:1630337102:1.text: They say there's a giant man-eating tree that mimics human voices to lure people close... then gobbles them up!
say:2:1630337102:1.source_cn: 据说是因为森林里有一棵会吃人的巨树，它会发出人类的声音...
say:2:1630337102:1.male: They say there's a giant man-eating tree that mimics human voices to lure people close... then gobbles them up!
say:2:1630337102:1.female: They say there's a giant man-eating tree that mimics human voices to lure people close... then gobbles them up!

say:3:1630337103:1.text: The story freaked people out so much. Now anyone who enters the forest just zips their lips. That way, if they hear a voice, they know it's the tree.
say:3:1630337103:1.source_cn: 这件事传得神神叨叨的，导致进入森林的人干脆就都不说话了...
say:3:1630337103:1.male: The story freaked people out so much. Now anyone who enters the forest just zips their lips. That way, if they hear a voice, they know it's the tree.
say:3:1630337103:1.female: The story freaked people out so much. Now anyone who enters the forest just zips their lips. That way, if they hear a voice, they know it's the tree.

say:4:1630337104:1.text: You know what? Works for me. Peace and quiet at last.
say:4:1630337104:1.source_cn: 这样也挺好的，我总算找到一片安静的栖息地。
say:4:1630337104:1.male: You know what? Works for me. Peace and quiet at last.
say:4:1630337104:1.female: You know what? Works for me. Peace and quiet at last.

say:6:1630337105:1.text: I've never seen this giant tree. And even if I did... how would I know it's the one?
say:6:1630337105:1.source_cn: 我没有见到过什么巨树。就算我见到了，我也认不出来。
say:6:1630337105:1.male: I've never seen this giant tree. And even if I did... how would I know it's the one?
say:6:1630337105:1.female: I've never seen this giant tree. And even if I did... how would I know it's the one?

say:7:1630337106:1.text: That's living-people stuff. I'm a ghost. Big spooky trees don't scare me.
say:7:1630337106:1.source_cn: 而且那都是你们活人需要害怕的东西。我已经死了，我不用怕。
say:7:1630337106:1.male: That's living-people stuff. I'm a ghost. Big spooky trees don't scare me.
say:7:1630337106:1.female: That's living-people stuff. I'm a ghost. Big spooky trees don't scare me.

say:8:1630337107:1.text: And the living scare easily. Even the sight of poor, innocent me is enough to send them running and screaming.
say:8:1630337107:1.source_cn: 就好像你们很怕见到我们一样。
say:8:1630337107:1.male: And the living scare easily. Even the sight of poor, innocent me is enough to send them running and screaming.
say:8:1630337107:1.female: And the living scare easily. Even the sight of poor, innocent me is enough to send them running and screaming.

say:9:1630337108:1.text: But don't worry, I'm not the kind of ghost who goes around scaring people to death. Imagine how awkward that would be. Two ghosts just... staring at each other. Yikes.
say:9:1630337108:1.source_cn: 别误会，我可不会随随便便把谁吓死，不然两个灵魂面面相觑...
say:9:1630337108:1.male: But don't worry, I'm not the kind of ghost who goes around scaring people to death. Imagine how awkward that would be. Two ghosts just... staring at each other. Yikes.
say:9:1630337108:1.female: But don't worry, I'm not the kind of ghost who goes around scaring people to death. Imagine how awkward that would be. Two ghosts just... staring at each other. Yikes.
